name: Shtolnya
source:
A small scene in the library unfolding on the fifth day of Semyon Persunov's stay in the Sovyonok pioneer camp.
The "guardian of knowledge", Zhenya, is not particularly happy to see the pioneer who came for flour, just like anyone else who disturbs her peace. However, our shut-in protagonist is not ready to give up without a fight.

[Translated from [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3012754452]Steam[/url]]
